author: Cruyff
text_post: How many evenings to go out a week How many dates should I take my girlfriend out on in a month? Obviously, I'd love to take her out a lot, but it obviously takes money. But how often should I in order for her to avoid boredom and cabin fever? I always keep her well entertained at my place, but we do need to go out. AND my other perhaps more important though unrelated question is: how many times a week should I be doing something social in the evenings after work? I am a naturally introverted guy, but I do feel I need to maintain an active social life. Where do I draw the balance? I work 40 hrs weeks. A concern of mine (though not the foremost one) is that my girlfriend will fear me turning into a social pariah if I only go out every once in a while. I am generally very happy to only meet up with friends a few times a month and spend most evenings reading and lifting weights.

author: salsabor
text_post: How long is a piece of string? My advice to you is to build up your own social life. It does not have to revolve around clubbing, it can be a new hobby etc.. But something that you do yourself outside of her. When you have a social life , work, club for yourself outside of your girlfriend you will find that your relationships works a lot better. She will only get 'bored' etc... if she starts to feel that you are dependent on her, needy etc.. You can spend a lot of time with someone without making them feel that way. The key is to value having a life for yourself as well.

author: TheRogue
text_post: My bf and I rarely go out for classical dates. There are lots of ways you can go out without spending money. Anything that's related to fitness, like hiking, jogging, going to the beach, etc. makes for a good, cheap date. You can also check out local concerts, museums, and other things to do for free/cheap in your area. How often you go out depends on you and your gf. I never go out on weekdays because I'm usually in lab 12 hours a day and just don't have the time for it. However, I like to do at least one fun thing with my bf on the weekend (usually hiking or some other sport). Sometimes we'll hang out in a group of friends, just to keep in touch. You can also make lunch/dinner dates on weekdays with your friends to keep them in the loop and maintain some social life. Depends on your age too... I could party all the time when I was 18, but as you hit your mid-twenties, the responsibilities pile up and you don't have as much free time.  Rogue
